purpose: Irreducible atomic building blocks distilled from A01..A10 exhibits, live Crucible harness, 9 high-signal GitHub repositories, and selective skill extractions.

primitives.name: Ground-Truth Intake Gate
primitives.inputs: Empty or unfamiliar domain folder + user intent
primitives.mechanism: Block deliverable generation until GROUND_TRUTH.md captures workflow, audience, purpose, and missing-information boundaries.
primitives.outputs: Bounded scope + explicit blocking vs. non-blocking unknowns
primitives.breakpoints: Agents hallucinate deliverables in empty folders (SHIFTING_SAND) or optimize downstream details before settling audience and purpose.
primitives.receiving_check: Writing a deliverable into an empty domain folder is denied by PreToolUse until GROUND_TRUTH.md exists.

primitives.name: Scoped Commission & DAG Dependency Contract
primitives.inputs: Producer brief + authorized sources + acceptance checks
primitives.mechanism: Freeze immutable objective/scope separately from revisable drafts; validate section/task dependencies as an acyclic DAG (TopologicalSorter + JSON Schema).
primitives.outputs: Schema-validated commission packet + ordered execution graph
primitives.breakpoints: Circular dependencies, silent scope drift mid-run, or accepting prose completion without frozen criteria.
primitives.receiving_check: Cyclic dependency raises CycleError; mid-session contract mutation fails verify/stop gate.

primitives.name: Canon vs. Inference Epistemic Stratification
primitives.inputs: Participant proposals, drafts, or multi-agent observations
primitives.mechanism: Separate confirmed canon facts, inferred claims, unresolved unknowns, and proposed changes; block silent canon downgrades or unauthorized unknown-filling.
primitives.outputs: Tagged state update + explicit open-questions queue for decision owner
primitives.breakpoints: Participants silently fill restricted unknowns or treat speculative inference as confirmed canon.
primitives.receiving_check: A contradictory or ungrounded proposal is retained with its basis without overwriting confirmed canon.

primitives.name: Append-Once Operation Identity & Prerequisite Resume
primitives.inputs: Step execution attempt + prior checkpoint/journal state
primitives.mechanism: Assign unique operation/event IDs to prevent duplicate appends on retry, and preserve FAILED prerequisite status so resume halts rather than skipping forward.
primitives.outputs: Idempotent event log + honest resume state
primitives.breakpoints: Double-append on save/evolution (A01) or resuming past a failed prerequisite and reporting COMPLETED (A09 / K-ARCH-01).
primitives.receiving_check: Resume fixture with a FAILED prerequisite halts downstream steps; retry preserves one logical event record.

primitives.name: Dual-Hash Media & Artifact Custody Receipt
primitives.inputs: Source media/card or artifact file + copy target
primitives.mechanism: Compute single-pass MD5 + SHA-256 verification receipts bound to exact version/path without granting destructive source-erase authority.
primitives.breakpoints: Silent bit-rot, copy-vs-source confusion, or premature deletion before independent checksum verification.
primitives.receiving_check: Altered byte triggers checksum mismatch warning; source-erase remains gated.

primitives.name: In-RAM Capability Routing & Selective Abstention
primitives.inputs: Natural-language task, canonical ID, or problem statement
primitives.mechanism: Index local registers, procedures, exhibits, skills, and primitives in RAM (<50ms); abstain on out-of-domain noise instead of forcing irrelevant matches.
primitives.outputs: Ranked exact/lexical matches + prior-art Forge brief, or explicit ABSTAINED
primitives.breakpoints: Slow external vector bloat without counterfactual gain (K-ARCH-02) or noisy keyword matches across unrelated domains.
primitives.receiving_check: Exact IDs resolve O(1); out-of-domain noise abstains cleanly while keeping TQ floor.

primitives.name: Deterministic Repo Sieve (No-Clone Ore Triage)
primitives.inputs: GitHub owner inventory + local exhibit directory
primitives.mechanism: Subtract already-melted exhibits, detect stale pushes, skip stubs, and inspect max 5 repo trees/call via read-only API without cloning binaries.
primitives.breakpoints: Cloning multi-GB asset repos, crashing on 409 empty repos, or burning tokens dumping raw source.
primitives.receiving_check: Batch >5 exits 2; 409 empty repo isolates cleanly; binary assets are filtered.

primitives.name: AST Code Property Graph & Reachability Audit
primitives.mechanism: Build stdlib AST call/import graphs, trace taint/dataflow, and compute transitive BFS reachability from real entrypoints vs. test-only islands.
primitives.breakpoints: Reporting a module as wired when only unit tests import it and no real CLI/hook entrypoint reaches it.
primitives.receiving_check: Module imported solely by tests is flagged unreachable from production entrypoints.

primitives.name: Mechanical Test Quality & Deceptive-Fix Gate
primitives.inputs: Candidate test file or code diff
primitives.mechanism: Enforce AST rules TQ-01..TQ-05 (real assertions, no unconditional skips, portable paths, live exec + negative path), block swallowed exceptions, and scan deceptive-fix patterns.
primitives.outputs: PASS or deterministic PreToolUse DENY with exact rule ID + line
primitives.breakpoints: Tests passing via assert True, hardcoded user paths, mocked-out core logic, or silent except: pass.
primitives.receiving_check: Writing a tautological or skipped test is denied mechanically before disk mutation.

primitives.name: Schema-Bound A/V Script & Structural Deconstructor
primitives.inputs: Verified source material, transcript, or structured script JSON
primitives.mechanism: Separate authoring judgment from deterministic validation/export (JSON <-> 3-column DOCX, non-destructive DOCX diff/inspect, 12-role narrative beat tagging).
primitives.outputs: Editable Section | Audio | Video script + traceable source-clip manifest
primitives.breakpoints: LLM inventing ungrounded visual claims, mutating original DOCX files, or mixing timecodes/slop into spoken copy.
primitives.receiving_check: av_script check/export/diff validates schema without modifying source DOCX.

primitives.name: Multi-Perspective Synthesis & Claim-Bound Objection
primitives.inputs: Shared bounded brief + independent worker outputs or reviewer objections
primitives.mechanism: Feed one brief to independent perspectives, reconcile conflicts without flattening counterevidence, and let source-bound objections block completion until affected checks refresh.
primitives.outputs: Reconciled decision brief + open objection ledger + human approval target
primitives.breakpoints: Mistaking worker agreement for approval or letting stale passing checks survive a material revision.
primitives.receiving_check: Material candidate edit reopens affected checks; prior objections remain retrievable.

primitives.name: Exact-Version Receiving Check & 7-Graph View
primitives.mechanism: Bind delivery receipt to exact git/file revision, distinguish draft vs. readback vs. approval (K-WOS-02/03), and render cross-project dependencies with solid (blocking) vs. dashed (advisory) edges.
primitives.breakpoints: Assuming a local test proves the recipient's environment (K-WOS-03) or conflating delivery with approval.
primitives.receiving_check: Recipient opens exact version in target environment without clarification; receipt rejects cross-operation replay.

primitives.name: Brand-Locked Institutional Artifact & Stakeholder Risk Audit
primitives.inputs: Draft Markdown/JSON payload or transcript + institutional style contract + stakeholder/employer boundary rules
primitives.mechanism: Compile executive .docx deliverables against fixed corporate template geometry and color invariants while auditing prose for political friction, past-strategy critique, AI buzzwords, and employer-data isolation.
primitives.breakpoints: Hardcoded local OS template paths (e.g. macOS user paths in mugen executive compiler), unstyled markdown dumps, or employer-restricted source leakage.
primitives.receiving_check: Generated .docx preserves template geometry, gridlines, and color tokens cleanly on target OS and passes stakeholder-risk plus read-only employer boundary checks.
